PythonScript.title: PythonScript
PythonScript.description: A Python source file stored in the user's cloud IDE workspace, supporting standard scripts, data science notebooks, 3D parametric models, and automation scripts.

content.description: Full Python source code content (0-100000 characters).

description.description: Short summary of what the script does (0-300 characters).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on create.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on create/update.

AutomatedAppRecord.title: AutomatedAppRecord
AutomatedAppRecord.description: A user-built or AI-generated fully automated micro-application backed by executable Python logic, reactive UI controls, scheduled triggers, and optional 3D rendering.

name.description: Display name of the automated app (1-80 characters).

summary.description: Short description of the automated app (0-300 characters).

pythonCode.description: Python execution code invoked when app triggers fire (0-100000 characters).

inputsSpec.description: Pipe-delimited or structured control specification for interactive inputs (0-20000 characters).

intervalSeconds.description: Auto-run interval in seconds when triggerMode is INTERVAL (0-3600).

has3dViewport.description: Whether the automated app embeds an interactive GPU-accelerated 3D viewport.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on create.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on create/update.

/users/{userId}/scripts/{scriptId}.description: User-owned Python workspace scripts and 3D model source files.
